changes.change_text: Fireball Barrage: Added a new Specialization requiring 5 points.
sub_lines: When enabled, Fireball Barrage has an 80% chance to reduce the target's Damage Reduction by 30 for 5 seconds with a max stack count of 10.
Fireball Barrage's cooldown is increased by 9s when the Specialization is enabled.
This Specialization cannot be activated alongside the Mana Burn Specialization.
The Damage Reduction effect is only applied once even if multiple players hit the same target with Fireball Barrage while the Specialization is active.

changes.change_text: Mastery: Added additional effects to Dark Apostasy.
sub_lines: Corrupted Obliteration and Obliterating Swamp now have an 80% chance to reduce the target's Damage Reduction by 40 for 3 seconds with a max stack count of 5.
Slothful Cage now has an 80% chance to reduce Shield Block Chance by 30% for 4 seconds.

changes.change_text: Summon Satellite: Increased the damage dealt when using Stellar Dash from 145% + 53 to 181% + 66.
Summon Satellite: Decreased the damage dealt against monsters from 100% to 60%.
Summon Constellation: Added a new Specialization requiring 5 points.
sub_lines: When enabled, has an 80% chance to reduce Shield Block Chance by 30% for 4 seconds.
This Specialization can be used alongside the Milky Way Specialization.

changes.change_text: Flash Wave: Fixed an issue causing the Range Increase Specialization to not increase Flash Wave's width.
